Promote a culture of end-to-end ownership, where engineers build, operate, measure, and continuously improve the systems they own.

Lead by example through thoughtful technical decisions, high-quality implementation, effective code reviews, and resolution of complex technical problems.

Collaborate with engineers and technical leaders across the organization to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, modernization, and platform improvement.

Technical and People Leadership: Demonstrated experience shaping architecture, leading complex initiatives, mentoring engineers, providing constructive feedback, and establishing clear ownership within teams.

Experience building and operating high-volume, business-critical payment or financial systems.

Experience integrating with payment providers such as Adyen, Braintree, PayPal, or similar payment platforms.

Strong understanding of payment processing concepts such as transaction lifecycles, idempotency, retries, failure handling, reconciliation, and distributed-system consistency.

Experience improving platform reliability, observability, incident response, and on-call effectiveness.

Experience leading architecture evolution, modernization, or migration of large-scale distributed systems.

Experience using AI-assisted development tools and AI-driven engineering practices to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery.

A passion for mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and contributing to the wider engineering community.

Experience working effectively in distributed teams and asynchronous collaboration environments.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

This is a unique opportunity to lead and shape a business-critical Payments Platform, working alongside a diverse and talented team of engineers across Cimpress. You will have the opportunity to solve challenging distributed-systems problems, influence technical direction, and build platforms that enable critical customer experiences across multiple businesses.

Through constant learning, collaboration, and exposure to what’s next, we encourage our people to keep pushing boundaries and broadening their horizons.

:

This role sits close to company strategy, not just code • Joining client or partner conversations to explain technical capabilities in plain language

 1–2 years of hands-on experience with embedded systems, IoT, or Linux-based hardware (Raspberry Pi experience is a strong plus) • Comfortable with Python and/or C for low-level device code • Some exposure to blockchain/crypto concepts (wallets, signatures, smart contracts, or similar); you don't need deep protocol expertise, but genuine curiosity and some hands-on tinkering • Working knowledge of Linux, basic networking, and command-line tools • Able to communicate clearly, comfortable explaining technical work to non-technical people • Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities; this role is shaped week to week by what the company needs, not a fixed job description • Based in or willing to relocate to MangaloreBonus points for: Go experience, exposure to zero-knowledge proofs, prior startup experience, or having built anything with a Raspberry Pi/Arduino outside of work.

**Why This Role**

As our first hire, you won't be slotted into an existing team structure; you'll help build it. You'll work in close daily contact with the founder/CEO, get visibility into how the company actually gets built (not just the engineering slice of it), real ownership over your work, and early-employee equity.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Agentic Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end architectural design of a next-generation agentic platform for Finance and Accounting operations. This is a foundational role — you will define how AI agents are designed, orchestrated, and governed across Purchase-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows, and you will own the architectural decisions that determine whether this platform can scale across dozens of client implementations without custom engineering work for each.

This role demands a rare combination: deep hands-on experience with LLMs and multi-agent systems, strong enterprise software architecture credentials, and enough Finance and Accounting domain literacy to make architectural trade-offs that are grounded in how finance operations actually work. You will collaborate with a cross-functional engineering team, work directly with client stakeholders and delivery leadership, and set the technical direction that AI engineers, backend engineers, integration specialists, and frontend engineers all build toward.

You will not just design on whiteboards — you are expected to be hands-on enough to validate architectural decisions through prototypes, review critical implementation choices, and course-correct when the team's execution drifts from the intended design.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the agentic platform — including agent orchestration framework, HITL engine, exception routing, integration layer, intelligence services, canonical data model, and workflow state store — ensuring all components are cohesive and scalable by design.
* Define the multi-agent design patterns used across the platform — agent boundaries, tool use contracts, inter-agent communication protocols, confidence thresholds, fallback routing, and human handoff triggers — and govern their consistent application across all workflow implementations.
* Lead the design of the workflow state management architecture — covering execution context persistence, checkpointing, idempotent retries, long-running process patterns, and safe resume — ensuring finance workflows that span days or weeks behave correctly under failure conditions.
* Establish the observability and governance architecture — structured logging, distributed tracing, model performance monitoring, SLA tracking, audit trail design, and compliance logging — ensuring the platform meets the control requirements of regulated finance environments.
* Evaluate and select foundational technologies — LLM providers, agentic frameworks (LangGraph or AutoGen or CrewAI), orchestration engines (Azure Durable Functions or Temporal), vector databases, and messaging infrastructure — with clear justification for each choice.
* Lead technical design reviews and architecture governance — reviewing critical implementation decisions made by AI engineers, backend engineers, and integration engineers, and ensuring they align with the platform's intended design.
* Work directly with client technical stakeholders during pre-sales, solutioning, and delivery — explaining architectural decisions, assessing client infrastructure constraints, and adapting the platform design to client-specific requirements without compromising reusability.
* Define and enforce non-functional requirements across the platform — latency SLAs, throughput targets, availability requirements, disaster recovery posture, and security controls — and validate that the implementation meets them.
* Build and maintain the technical roadmap for the platform — sequencing capability development, managing architectural debt, and ensuring the platform evolves coherently as new workflows and client requirements are added.
* Mentor and technically grow the engineering team — establishing architecture decision record (ADR) practices, conducting design reviews, and developing engineering standards that the team follows consistently.

Required Skills

* 12+ years of software architecture and engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems and at least 2 years hands-on with LLM-based or agentic applications in production.
* Deep expertise in multi-agent system design — agent orchestration, tool use, inter-agent communication, stateful agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop architecture using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
* Proven experience architecting event-driven, distributed systems on Azure at scale — Azure Durable Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps (AKS), Azure API Management, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and related services.
* Strong Python skills— sufficient to prototype architectural patterns, review implementation code critically, and validate that the team's code matches the intended design.
* Experience with MLOps and AI governance — model versioning, drift detection, evaluation pipelines, prompt management, and production monitoring for LLM-based services.
* Strong communication skills — able to explain complex architectural decisions to both engineering teams and non-technical client stakeholders, and to produce clear, concise architecture documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to make and defend technology selection decisions with clear trade-off analysis — including build vs. buy, framework selection, and infrastructure design choices.
* Hands-on experience delivering agentic or LLM-based systems in a finance, BPO, or shared services context — not just proof-of-concept projects but production deployments with real operational volume and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Deep familiarity with Finance and Accounting operations — P2P, O2C, and R2R processes, exception patterns, compliance controls, and the operational metrics (STP rate, first-pass match rate, exception aging) that define platform success.

* Prior experience in a shared services, or F&A technology consulting context — understanding how finance operations teams work and what makes a platform adoptable by non-technical operations staff.
* Contributions to open-source AI/agentic projects or published technical writing on multi-agent system design.

The role coordinates regression testing, environment readiness, defect follow-up, and QA sign-off while expanding automation across critical user journeys. **Release QA Ownership**

* Operationally own QA execution for each release, including test scope, regression sequencing, task allocation, and progress tracking.
* Confirm environment readiness, test data, access, and build availability before testing; coordinate resolution of blockers.
* Execute and coordinate functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing across critical workflows.
* Coordinate defect triage, retesting, and closure with development teams, and escalate unresolved release risks promptly.

**Test Automation and Continuous Improvement**

* Build, maintain, and improve automated tests across critical user journeys, prioritising business risk and repeatable regression scenarios.

* Maintain and manage the test case repository, keeping cases current, reusable, prioritised, and linked to requirements and execution results.
* Review test coverage when requirements change and identify gaps before release testing begins.

**Mentoring and Quality Reporting**

* Mentor junior QA engineers through task allocation, practical guidance, and review of test cases, defect reports, automation, and execution outputs.
* Balance testing priorities and team capacity, escalating delivery risks or resource constraints to the Quality Lead.
* Report defect escape rate, regression cycle time, and automation coverage to the Quality Lead and Department Head, using agreed definitions and consistent data.
* Highlight quality trends and recurring defects, recommend improvements, and track agreed actions.

**Experience and Skills**

**Essential**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in manual testing and test automation.
* Strong banking and fintech domain knowledge, with the ability to assess critical financial workflows, business rules, and transaction risks.

**Company Description**
Aegan Global (Aegan Technologies) is a digital engineering and talent orchestration company that helps organizations accelerate transformation and build high-performing technology teams. The company brings together specialized expertise across AI and Data, Cloud, Software Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Semiconductor Engineering, Healthcare Technology, and other emerging domains. By combining digital engineering capabilities with a strong global talent network, Aegan enables clients to access the right skills at the right time. With a presence in India, Malaysia, and the USA, Aegan focuses on agile delivery, domain depth, and client-centric engagement.

**Security Engineer**

Experience - 6 to 9 yrs

As a Security Engineer (Information Security), you will be a hands-on member of the Information Security team, helping to drive the security strategy in close alignment with business objectives. Working alongside Platform, Cloud and Engineering teams, you will strengthen the security posture of a PCI-DSS regulated core payments platform across cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

The platform runs an estate of Windows servers on AWS and is moving rapidly to containers, Lambda and cloud-native services, managed as code. In this role your focus will be embedding security into release pipelines and securing the AWS environment. You will also drive vulnerabilities through to closure, keep security telemetry healthy, and pick up alerts escalated by the managed SOC (Arctic Wolf). You will also support the lifecycle of cryptographic keys, acting as a designated Key Custodian.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Maintain and extend automated security guardrails in deployment pipelines (e.g., Checkov, Trivy, Snyk Enterprise, Renovate) to block preventable issues and enable engineers to ship securely.
* Embed security into Infrastructure as Code (IaC) patterns as the platform moves from a Windows server estate to containers, Lambda and cloud-native services, hardening release processes and collaborating with Platform Engineering and the security champions network.
* Triage and remediate AWS misconfigurations surfaced by AWS Security Hub, working closely with Platform and Engineering teams to resolve insecure configurations.
* Review overly permissive security groups, network paths and IAM permissions, ensuring strict adherence to the Principle of Least Privilege and Role Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Conduct periodic reviews and testing of security controls to validate that they work and remain aligned with organisational risk standards.
* Conduct risk scoring against vulnerabilities from Tenable (legacy estate), AWS Inspector (cloud-native) and Snyk to prioritise effort, ensuring patching tickets are raised, owned and actioned by the right teams and tracked through to completion.
* Monitor and maintain security telemetry so tooling is always running correctly, including log collectors, Arctic Wolf sensors and Sophos EDR agents feeding the Arctic Wolf SIEM.
* Investigate security alerts triaged by the Arctic Wolf 24/7 SOC and escalated via Slack, gathering evidence and following and improving incident response runbooks during active security events.
* Work with the MSSP to tune alerts (aligned to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK) and close detection gaps across AWS, Lambda and container workloads.
* Help strengthen escalation paths so that high and critical incidents raised outside UK business hours are not missed.
* Build automations to streamline security response and gather technical evidence for audits (e.g., PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
* Support the lifecycle of cryptographic keys, from generation, distribution, rotation and storage to retirement and destruction, in accordance with policies and procedures.

**These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:**

* Thriving in a growth-focused retail environment where commercial decisions directly influence customers, sales, margin, and competitiveness

**Why this role exists:**

The Associate Space Optimization Analyst exists to increase the capacity, consistency and analytical capability of the Space Planning function. The role builds and improves the platforms, automation and data solutions that reduce manual planning effort, strengthen output quality and enable planners to focus on higher-value work.

Working across Blue Yonder, monday.com, and supporting data environments, the role embeds scalable and controlled solutions into core planning workflows. It provides reliable analysis and insight to improve space utilization, supports informed decision-making and ensures planning tools and data remain accurate, available and fit for purpose.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Space Planning Platforms and Tools:**

* Build, configure and continuously improve the platforms, tools and data solutions that support space planning activities.
* Support the ongoing development and administration of Blue Yonder, monday.com and other insights & automation platforms.
* Translate planner and business requirements into clear technical specifications, scalable solutions and practical enhancements.
* Test and validate platform changes before release, ensuring solutions meet user, data and control requirements.
* Maintain appropriate system documentation, access controls and change records in line with enterprise technology and risk requirements.
* Workflow Automation and Planning Capacity
* Analyse end-to-end planning workflows to identify repeatable, manual or high-effort activities suitable for automation.
* Design, test and implement automation solutions that improve efficiency, consistency and output quality.
* Embed approved automation into core planning workflows, supported by clear process controls, documentation and exception handling.
* Measure the adoption and impact of automation, including planning hours released, activity volumes automated and reductions in rework.
* Review implemented solutions and user feedback to identify further optimization opportunities.
* Space Analytics and Decision Support
* Build and maintain data models, reports and visualisations that improve visibility of space utilization and planning performance.
* Integrate relevant store, product, category and space data to produce accurate and actionable analysis.
* Identify space productivity trends, data anomalies and opportunities to improve space utilisation.

* Partner with Space Planners and specialist leads to understand planning pain points, prioritise improvements and refine solution requirements. Support users through training, guidance and issue resolution to improve adoption of planning platforms and automated workflows.
* Establish consistent data, automation and platform practices across the Space Planning function.
* Coordinate vendor support and enhancement activities, escalating material platform, data or delivery risks when required.
* Contribute technical expertise to broader range, space and store planning improvement initiatives.

* Space Leadership and Planning Teams: Consult regularly with the Space Senior Manager, Space Team Leader, Micro Space Lead, Capacity & Adjacency Lead, and Space Planners to understand workflow friction and deploy automated tools.

* External Platform Vendors: Liaise with software vendors (Blue Yonder, monday.com etc.) and technical consultants to resolve system issues, perform platform upgrades, and manage software releases

**What success looks like:**

* Space Productivity: Measured improvement in retail space utilization and GMROS delivered through data-driven space insights.
* Platform Availability: High Scalene and space management platform availability with fast issue-resolution turnaround times. Data Accuracy: High reporting accuracy rate and low error frequency across automated spatial databases and reporting dashboards.

* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary qualification in Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline is required (or equivalent technical and retail-planning experience).
* Experience: 3–5+ years in commercial analytics, space planning automation, systems improvement, or retail planning, including experience building and supporting data-driven tools or platforms.
* Technical Analytics Capability: Strong knowledge of space-planning platforms, spatial data structures, automation methodologies, and analytical modelling.
* Data Tooling Proficiency: Advanced Excel, SQL, and data-visualization capability (Power BI / Tableau), with practical experience extracting and analysing large retail data sets
* Workflow Automation: Practical experience improving space planning workflows, system controls, automated planogram logic, and space-utilization analysis.

* Preferred
* Scripting Expertise: Practical scripting capability in Python, SQL, R, or VBA for spatial data automation and API integrations

title: Senior Consultant
description:

****L3 Infrastructure Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
specializing in
**VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)**
and
**Dell Enterprise Hardware**
.**
****VMware Engineering & Operations****
**Architecture & Design:**

* Design and architect advanced VMware environments:

+ vSphere & ESXi cluster architecture and best practices
+ vCenter multi-cluster management and federation
+ vSAN (Software-Defined Storage) design and optimization
+ NSX (Network Virtualization) security policies and micro-segmentation

* Evaluate new VMware technologies and recommend adoption strategies
* Develop infrastructure standards and design documentation

****Dell Hardware Lifecycle & Diagnostics****
**Hardware Administration:**

* Administer enterprise Dell server hardware across multiple form factors:

+ PowerEdge Rack Servers (1U, 2U configurations)
+ PowerEdge Tower Servers (for edge/remote deployments)
+ Modular MX Chassis with blade server management
+ VxRail Hyperconverged Infrastructure (HCI) systems

* Manage hardware inventory, asset tracking, and lifecycle planning

**Diagnostics & Troubleshooting:**

* Troubleshoot hardware issues using:

+ iDRAC (Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller) for remote management
+ Lifecycle Controller for firmware updates and BIOS configuration
+ OpenManage Enterprise (OME) for centralized monitoring and alerting
+ Dell Diagnostics and hardware health monitoring tools

* Perform hardware health checks, firmware diagnostics, and performance validation
* Coordinate with Dell support for warranty claims and hardware replacement

**Firmware & Configuration Management:**

* Create and maintain firmware baselines across hardware generations
* Develop BIOS configuration templates for standardized deployments
* Manage firmware update cycles and patch management
* Document hardware configurations and maintain configuration baselines

**Configuration & Deployment:**

* Configure and deploy VMware environments:

+ ESXi host configuration, clustering, and resource management
+ vCenter Server setup, backup, and high availability
+ vSAN cluster configuration with fault domains and storage policies
+ NSX deployment including logical switches, routers, and security groups

* Implement high-availability (HA), fault tolerance (FT), and disaster recovery mechanisms
* Manage vMotion, storage vMotion, and cluster resource balancing

****Automation****
**Automation Development:**

* Drive automation-first culture across infrastructure operations
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools using:

+ PowerCLI for VMware vSphere automation
+ PowerShell for Windows and Dell hardware automation
+ Ansible for cross-platform orchestration and configuration management
+ Python for custom tooling, integrations, and API development

* Build self-service infrastructure provisioning workflows
* Automate routine operational tasks (patching, backups, health checks)

**Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC):**

* Implement Git/GitHub version control for all infrastructure code
* Develop and maintain IaC templates for:

+ Cluster deployments and configurations
+ Virtual machine provisioning
+ Network and security policies
+ Backup and disaster recovery configurations

* Establish CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes
* Document IaC standards and best practices

****Performance Tuning & Recovery****
**Performance Optimization:**

* Optimize resource allocation and utilization:

+ CPU and memory resource pools and reservations
+ Storage performance tuning and I/O optimization
+ Network bandwidth management and latency reduction
+ vSAN performance tuning and policy optimization

* Monitor performance metrics and identify bottlenecks
* Conduct capacity planning and right-sizing assessments
* Implement performance baselines and SLA monitoring

**About You**
****Required Qualifications****
****Experience****

* 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience
* 3+ years of hands-on VMware vSphere administration (vCenter, ESXi, vSAN)
* 3+ years of Dell PowerEdge server administration and troubleshooting
* 2+ years of L3-level incident management and problem resolution
* 2+ years of infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, or Ansible

****Technical Skills****
**Virtualization**
VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX; HA/FT/DRS configuration
**Hardware**
Dell PowerEdge (Rack/Tower/MX), VxRail; iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, OME
**Scripting**
PowerCLI, PowerShell, Ansible, Python
**Version Control**
Git/GitHub; CI/CD pipeline concepts
**Disaster Recovery**
SRM and/or Zerto; backup solutions (Veeam, Veritas, etc.)
**Storage**
vSAN, SSD/HDD management, storage performance tuning
**Networking**
NSX, VLAN, TCP/IP, network troubleshooting
**Incident Management**
RCA, troubleshooting methodology, escalation procedures
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred)**

* VMware Certified Professional

**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.
